form.withholding_hint: Usually 15% (7% in the first 3 years) if the customer is a Spanish business
form.fx_get: Get the ECB rate for the invoice date
form.fx_hint: The euro base is the amount divided by the rate. IVA law (art. 79 LIVA) uses the Banco de España selling rate at the accrual date, normally the invoice date; the ECB reference rate it is based on is the usual source. The rate and where it came from are saved with the entry.

settings.fx_auto: Automatic (ECB reference rate of the invoice date, looked up online)
settings.fx_hint: Rates that were looked up are stored, so each one is fetched only once.
form.eur_note: Enter amounts in euros, at the rate on the invoice or bank statement. Foreign VAT and no IVA number: choose «No IVA» and enter the whole amount as the base.
form.help_eu_reverse: An EU supplier invoiced without IVA. You self-assess IVA (303: casillas 10/11) and deduct it (36/37). Modelo 349 is also required. Enter the rate that would apply in Spain (usually 21%).
form.help_non_eu_reverse: A supplier outside the EU (e.g. USA) without IVA. IVA is self-assessed (303: casillas 12/13) and deducted (28/29). The rate is usually 21%.
form.help_no_vat: The IVA columns stay empty. The whole base counts as an IRPF expense according to the category rules.
form.help_eu_b2b: A service to an EU business: no IVA is charged; modelo 349 and ROI registration are required.
form.help_non_eu: Customer outside the EU: no IVA is charged (not subject by place-of-supply rules).

filings.intro: Deadlines follow the AEAT calendar. A weekend or one of your holidays from Settings moves a date to the next business day. Any date can be edited by hand.

cats.cap_hint: Annual cap: the IRPF deduction of the category cannot exceed this amount per calendar year (e.g. health insurance 500 € per person). Empty = no cap.
cat.software.note: AI and service subscriptions. The invoice must be in your name/NIF.
cat.reta.note: Social security contribution: an IRPF expense, no IVA.
cat.health.note: IRPF limit: 500 €/year per person (1,500 € if disabled). Set the annual cap in this table.
cat.mobile.note: Only if the line is used exclusively for work; otherwise apportion it.

cat.rent.note: IRPF: the rent/IBI rule from Settings. No IVA.

cat.equipment.note: Purchases over 300 € are usually depreciated over several years: enter each year's amount as an expense.
cat.nondeductible.note: Recorded without deduction (personal expenses, fines, etc.).

import.title: Import entries from CSV
import.intro: Upload a CSV file with one row per invoice. A preview shows what will be stored before anything is saved.
import.columns_help: Required: date and base (or orig_amount with a currency). The other columns are optional and blank values take the defaults from Settings: date, kind (expense or income), number, counterparty, country, vat_id, description, category (code or name; required for expenses), regime, currency, orig_amount, base, vat_rate, vat_amount, withholding_rate, notes. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY; amounts are written like 1234.56. For a foreign currency leave base empty: the ECB rate of the invoice date is looked up. The separator can be ; , or a tab.

submit.title: Submit to the AEAT
submit.intro: Declarations sent here go to the AEAT test environment and have no legal effect. Use it to check that the connection, the certificate and the file work before the first real filing.
submit.hours_warning: The test environment answers on working days from 8:00 to 15:00 (Spain); outside these hours the call is likely to fail.
submit.cert_none: No certificate for client authentication was found in your Windows certificate store. Install your digital certificate (for example from the FNMT) and reload the page.
submit.cert_hint: Windows signs the connection with the certificate and may ask for your PIN.
submit.err_unknown_certificate: That certificate is not in your Windows store.
submit.nrc_hint: Pay the amount at your bank first; the bank gives you a 22-character NRC.
submit.review_intro: Sending means that you accept these data as your declaration. A declaration recorded by the AEAT cannot be annulled; a mistake is corrected with a complementary declaration.
submit.confirm_check: I have reviewed the data and they are those of my declaration.
submit.send_btn: Send to the AEAT test environment
